message.content: {"basis": "The chart shows May's release volume as a bar that is visibly the shortest on the dashboard, sitting near the broken baseline just above the 10,000 m³ tick. All other displayed months (Apr, Jan, Jun, Feb, Mar) have bars that are significantly taller, ranging from roughly 17,500 m³ to 40,000 m³. Because May is an extreme outlier—far below every other month in the reporting cycle—it is treated as a critical low-release anomaly rather than a standard low-release case. The 'background filing' option is ruled out because May clearly requires active routing as a low-release event.", "option_label": "Escalate May to critical low-release anomaly review"}
